name: fused_qk_gemma_rmsnorm_rope_gate
description: Apply Gemma RMSNorm independently per query and key head with weights interpreted as 1+w. Round the normalized values to the input dtype before applying NeoX-style rotary embedding on the first rotary_dim lanes using positions and the cos/sin cache. Keep the remaining normalized lanes. With has_gate=True, q_gate packs query and gate for each head; copy the unchanged gate into a new [T,num_q_heads,head_dim] tensor. With has_gate=False, the third return is None. The first two outputs are newly allocated [T,num_q_heads*head_dim] and [T,num_kv_heads*head_dim] tensors.
